description: Solar Together Installations is a dataset listed in Westofenglandca open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by The West of England Combined Authority. This dataset shows the spatial distribution of solar photovoltaic and battery storage installations through the Solar Together West of England scheme. This dataset is sourced from our delivery partners iChoosr. Round one installations took place in 2021 and round two installations took place in 2023-24. Round 3 installations are due to take place in 2025. Coverage: West of England Combined Authority area. The portal files it under Environment, Economy and Business. Its keywords are solar, Energy, retrofit, Net zero. The portal shows 130 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-08-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL v.3 (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-westofengland-ca-gov-uk-portal.
